property_summary: If sudicideAnyone is called by the saved owner (smartfix_owner), the contract self-destructs and sends its balance to the caller (msg.sender); the mutant that always sends to smartfix_owner will still satisfy this when caller==smartfix_owner but will differ when caller != smartfix_owner because the reference sends funds to caller while the mutant sends to the stored owner.

For any caller, when sudicideAnyone is invoked by the stored owner the contract self-destructs and transfers its balance to the caller (msg.sender) — the mutant that always targets smartfix_owner instead will fail to send the balance to the caller when the caller is a different address.

For any caller who is the saved owner, calling sudicideAnyone causes the contract balance to be transferred to the caller (address(c).balance becomes 0 and caller balance increases); the mutant that redirects the selfdestruct to smartfix_owner will still send to the stored owner, so when the caller is a different address the contract balance is not sent to the caller — thus the reference always makes address(c).balance == 0 after the call by saved owner and the mutant breaks this for some caller/owner combinations.

If a non-owner externally calls sudicideAnyone, the call reverts (only the stored owner can successfully invoke selfdestruct); the mutant that redirects the selfdestruct target does not change this rule, so to distinguish we instead assert that only the stored owner can successfully call sudicideAnyone — the reference reverts for non-owners and the mutant also should, but the meaningful distinguishing universal rule is: only smartfix_owner can successfully call sudicideAnyone (call succeeds iff caller == smartfix_owner).

For every caller who is the stored smartfix_owner, calling sudicideAnyone causes the contract to self-destruct and transfer its entire balance to the caller (so address(c).balance == 0 after the call); the mutant that always targets smartfix_owner for the selfdestruct can violate this when the caller is an address different from the stored owner (the caller won't receive the funds), so the property distinguishes the two.
